The philosophy

The Path of Mastery

From Foundation to Understanding. From Understanding to Mastery.

I — FOUNDATION

Learn the basics.

Every great discipline begins with understanding its fundamental principles.

II — COMPREHENSION

Connect the concepts.

Knowledge becomes powerful when individual ideas begin to form a larger picture.

III — APPLICATION

Put knowledge into practice.

True understanding reveals itself when you can use what you have learned.

IV — MASTERY

Teach, solve, create.

Mastery is not knowing everything. It is knowing how to think.

Ask better questions. Understand the answer. Apply what you learn. Keep progressing.
